hypotheses.T1_powerlaw_bulk_all_layers: Every observed full-width tensor-map spectrum has bulk log-log R2 at least 0.90.
hypotheses.T2_nulls_retain_bulk: At every layer and for both null families, median bulk exponent is within 0.15 of observed and median R2 is at least 0.90.
hypotheses.T3_observed_exceeds_null_median: At every layer, observed mean top-four log excess is larger than the median of both null families.
hypotheses.T4_strict_positive_outliers: At every layer, the observed leading singular value lies above the extrapolated fitted power law.
hypotheses.T5_late_full_width_concentration: Layer 17 full-width raw top-four fraction exceeds layers 0 and 8 by at least 0.005.
hypotheses.T6_late_exceeds_all_nulls: At layer 17, observed mean top-four log excess exceeds every sign and pairing null replicate.
